title: Taking The Long Way Home
summary:
Trans Mountain Expansion Will Transform Pacific Trades
In the second quarter of 2024, the Trans Mountain expansion project is expected be finalized. That is, if further delays can be avoided. The expansion will add about 590 thousand barrels of oil per day (b/d) of capacity to the Trans Mountain Pipeline, increasing it to 890 thousand b/d.
